newsitem.title: USA: Guangzhou Investment in U.S. paper talks.
newsitem.headline: Guangzhou Investment in U.S. paper talks.

text.p: Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd is in preliminary talks with a North American paper manufacturer to invest in its paper business, said Executive Director Yan Yuk Fung at the Jardine Fleming Asia Pacific Conference here. She declined to name the U.S. company.
The company's priorities going forward will be to focus more on consolidating businesses and upgrading them with the help of strategic investors, Fung said.
Guangzhou Investment, the biggest producer of cement in China's Guangdong province, has already brought in Belgian cement manufacturer CBR to upgrade technology and efficiency.
CBR has a five percent stake in the group, and Fung said they are negotiating for CBR to increase this stake.
She said that the property market in Guangzhou city is "a bit slow" and that the company is "still seeing a bit of oversupply in up market properties."
At the same time, she said, there is a shortage of mass properties for local buyers and this is where the group will concentrate resources in the future.
Guangzhou Investment is the listed vehicle for the Guangzhou municipal government. It is engaged in property development and basic industry projects.
